card.name: Split pieces inside mg/dL and hydrated
card.fires_on: Responds to the small piece "d" or "/d" inside units such as mg/dL and mg/dose, and to "-h" in "well-hydrated". Seen in dosing and lab-value text.

modes.label: Unit pieces
modes.description: The "/d" piece after mg in units like mg/dL or mg/dose.

modes.label: Hydrated and other split words
modes.description: A hyphen-h or h piece in the middle of a word such as well-hydrated.

card.plain: It fires on the "d" part of units like mg/dL and on the start of "hydrated" when the text is split into pieces.
